 Soyou collaborates with MC Tran Anh Huy | "Like to buy - If you like it, buy it"
 "Like to buy" is a new entertainment program combining experiences, content creation, and livestreaming, featuring former SISTAR member Soyou, MC Tran Anh Huy, Cheon Minuk, and four Vietnamese KOLs.
 Đài Phát thanh và Truyền hình Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh • 08/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 "Like to buy" will officially air at 2 PM today (November 8th) on HTV7. 
 The "Like to Buy" program has officially launched, exploring a hybrid format combining entertainment and online commerce. Through interactive activities, experiences, and challenges, the program captures how artists and content creators express their personalities and interact with their audience.
 A notable feature is the participation of two MCs from Vietnam and South Korea . Soyou (소유), a former member of the girl group SISTAR, serves as the Korean MC. She is joined by MC Tran Anh Huy, who connects and guides the program's activities.
 In addition, special guest Cheon Minuk (천민욱) also participated in the program. He is known to the audience through the program Paradise Island. Cheon Minuk's appearance along with the Vietnamese guests created diverse interactions in the experiential activities. 
 You may also like Vietnamese KOLs participate in "Like to buy - If you like it, buy it" 
 Vietnamese KOLs participate in Like to Buy - If you like it, buy it!
 Joining the two Korean MCs and guests are four Vietnamese KOLs/KOCs: Nam Khánh, Kanhy, Reency Ngô, and Đoàn Vân Anh (Vanjinka).
 Each person has their own unique content creation style. Therefore, the program not only explores conversations between artists but also presents challenges for guests to showcase their creativity and communication skills on online platforms.
 According to the format, members will explore and experience the product together, create content, and participate in livestreams. Through this, the program combines in-studio entertainment with popular forms of interaction on social media. 
 Soyou teams up with MC Tran Anh Huy in the new show "Like to buy - If you like it, buy it". 
 You may also like Like to buy: Entertainment combined with online commerce.
 "Like to buy" is structured as a studio show, combining live video recordings (VCR) and livestreaming. This approach integrates interaction, experiences, and online activities.
 Through this format, the program explores the role of content creators in the entertainment and digital commerce fields. Besides showcasing their skills in front of the camera, guests also have the opportunity to test their content creation abilities and interact directly with viewers.
 With a collaboration between Vietnamese and Korean artists, "Like to buy" also incorporates lifestyle themes and entertainment trends from both countries into its program content.
 "Like to buy" airs at 2 PM today (November 8th) on HTV7.
